lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 服务员，菜单给我们看一看。
lines.english: Waiter, please show us the menu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 好的，先生。这是菜单。请慢用。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de, xiānsheng. Zhè shì càidān. Qǐng màn yòng.
lines.english: Okay, sir. Here's the menu. Take your time.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 我们要两个菜：红烧肉、青菜。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen yào liǎng ge cài: hóngshāoròu, qīngcài.
lines.english: We want two dishes: braised pork and greens.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 要，两碗米饭。还要一瓶啤酒。
lines.pinyin: Yào, liǎng wǎn mǐfàn. Hái yào yī píng píjiǔ.
lines.english: Yes, two bowls of rice. Also a bottle of beer.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 好，一共一百八十元。请稍等。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, yīgòng yībǎi bāshí yuán. Qǐng shāoděng.
lines.english: Okay, 180 yuan total. Please wait a moment.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 菜很好吃。下次还来这儿吃。
lines.pinyin: Cài hěn hǎochī. Xiàcì hái lái zhèr chī.
lines.english: The food is delicious. We'll come eat here again next time.
